scope: Private independent validation and generated-only refinement controls, not diffusion sampling

protocol.perturbation: partial-perturbed-nz adds +0.75 angstrom to NZ x only
protocol.source_projection: ATOM records only; original fixture retained unchanged

independent_audits: Source digest and recomputed source-bound partial masks
Exact source-plus-generated identity set, including preserved source hydrogen observations
Verbatim ordered source ATOM/HETATM/ANISOU and explicit link records
Canonical generated atom names, residue chemistry and elements
Shared diagnose bond lengths/angles, peptide omegas, chirality, Ramachandran, chi12, coincidences and sterics
Explicit target-neighbour C-N checks independent of inferred topology bonds
Global zero D-C-alpha invariant; no observed sidechain reflection
Source missing atoms/gaps and all source geometry findings retained
Failed kernels retain raw candidate bytes and raw diagnostics; refined geometry rejection is not hidden
limitations: No profile advertises atom completion support and no public option is enabled
Refinement adapter is currently protein-only and refuses raw D-C-alpha candidates
Private geometry pass checks the changed residue/neighbour cohort and global chirality, not general input suitability
Outside-source findings remain visible and are not evidence of scientific qualification
Runner/context/engine transport, trace/provenance/.dat publication and scientific qualification remain open
